audience: shop and cafe owners who run their point of sale with Loyverse

useCases.title: Sum up sales receipts by store and period
useCases.text: The AI lists sales and refund receipts filtered by store or time range, reads line items, payments and discounts, and totals the sales.

useCases.title: Review the cash register shifts
useCases.text: The AI lists shifts with cash, gross and net sales, refunds, discounts, per-payment-type totals and pay-in and pay-out movements.

useCases.title: Find items that are running low
useCases.text: The AI lists the current stock per variant per store and matches it with the catalog items, SKUs and prices.

useCases.title: Set the stock of items after a count
useCases.text: The AI sets the exact stock of variants at stores. This overwrites the old level, so it first reads the current levels.

useCases.title: Look up loyalty customers or add and update one
useCases.text: The AI lists loyalty customers with visits, total spent and points, and reads one customer. It can create a customer or update an existing one.

useCases.title: Add or update item categories and suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists categories and suppliers, creates new ones, or renames and changes existing ones by id.
